• System: Bodywork

  • Device: Front door seal

  • Fault: Noise (creaking) coming from the front door frame when driving on uneven surfaces

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: - -

  • Cause: The creaking is caused by impurities on the roof surface in contact with the seal on the upper part of the door frame

• Action: Check the condition of the chassis surfaces in contact with the front door seal and clean them using concentrated silicone remover. If the fault persists, replace the seal itself.

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: Concentrated silicone remover code no. 83 12 2 298 199
